body: I’m with about 30 Christian leaders having some deep and needed conversation about Christian identity/ethos, mission, involvement in public policy, theology, history, and future possibilities. A rich time, a good spirit, and lots of laughter too. I’m blessed indeed. I was wondering if I’d have to change my travel plans to be in Gainesville, FL, tomorrow to protest the Quran burning in whatever ways I could. But thankfully that seems to be over with. God bless the peacemakers!
